harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «أفرأيت» is resumptive; it means "tell me" and takes two objects: the first is «مَنْ», a relative noun, and the second is a clause implied after «غشاوة», i.e. "will he be guided?". «اتخذ» takes two objects: «إلهه هواه». The preposition «على علم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Name of Majesty, and the preposition «على بصره» is attached to the second object. The clause «فمن يهديه» is resumptive, as is the clause «تَذَكَّرون».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «وقالوا» is resumptive; «هي ... حياتنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «نموت» is resumptive, and the clause «وما يهلكنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «نموت». The clause «وما لهم علم» is resumptive; «علم» is the mubtadaʾ and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «بذلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عِلْم». The clause «إن هم إلا يظنون» is resumptive, and «إن» is negative.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb), not to its apodosis «ما كان», because what follows «ما» does not govern what precedes it. «إذا» differs from the conditional particles in that the fāʾ is not joined to its apodosis when that is negated with «ما», unlike the others, with which the fāʾ is required, as in: «إن تزرنا فما جفوتنا» (if you visit us, then you have not been distant from us). «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آياتنا»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن قالوا» is the noun (ism) of «كان», and «حجتهم» is the khabar of «كان». The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «لا ريب فيه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «يوم القيامة», and the clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause of the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «ولله ملك» is resumptive. His words «ويوم»: the wāw is conjunctive; «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يخسر», and the clause «يخسر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause «لله ملك». «يومئذ» is a badal (substitute) from «يوم تقوم»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and its tanwīn is the tanwīn of compensation for an implied clause.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «وترى» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {يَخْسَرُ}; «جاثية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كل أمة», which is specified by the annexation, and the seeing is visual. «كل» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause «تُدْعَى» is the khabar (predicate). «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تجزون»; the clause «تجزون» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an implied saying; «ما» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «هذا كتابنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the clause «ينطق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كتابنا»; and the clause «إنَّا كنَّا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «أمَّا» is a particle of condition and detailing. The clause «فأما الذين....» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {هَذَا كِتَابُنَا}; the fāʾ in «فيدخلهم» is connective (rābiṭa), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «في رحمته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يدخلهم», and «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «أفلم تكن آياتي» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an implied saying, i.e. "then Allah will say to them: were not …"; the clause «فيقول الله» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين كفروا»; and the clause «فاستكبرتم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أفلم تكن آياتي».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The conditional clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «كنتم». The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar (verbal noun). The clause «والساعة لا ريب فيها» is conjoined to the clause «إن وعد الله حق», and the clause «لا ريب فيها» is the khabar (predicate) of «الساعة». The clause «ما ندري» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying), and the clause «ما الساعة» stands in place of the two objects of «ندري», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. The clause «إن نظن» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «ظناً» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «وما نحن بمستيقنين» is conjoined to the clause «إنْ نظن», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «وبدا لهم» is resumptive; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar (verbal noun). «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ننساكم»; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "We forget you with a forgetting like your forgetting". «هذا» is a naʿt (adjective); it is a non-derived noun interpreted as a derived one, i.e. "the one pointed to". The clause «ومأواكم النار» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «ننساكم», and the clause «وما لكم من ناصرين» is conjoined to the clause «مأواكم النار»; «ناصرين» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أنَّ» and what follows it is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «ذلكم». «هزوا» is the second object. The clause «وغَرَّتكم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «اتخذتم». The fāʾ in «فاليوم» is resumptive; the clause «لا يُخْرَجون» is resumptive, and the clause «ولا هم يُستعتبون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يُخرجون».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «فلله الحمد» is resumptive; the second «رب» is a badal (substitute), and the third «رب» is a badal from the second.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «وله الكبرياء» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ}; the preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكبرياء»; and the clause «وهو العزيز» is conjoined to the clause «له الكبرياء».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «تنزيل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); «الحكيم» is a second naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition phrase «للمؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «وفي خلقكم ... آيات» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إن في السماوات ... لآيات»; «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «خَلْقكم»; the preposition phrase «من دابة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «آيات» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «لقوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات»; and the clause «يوقنون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: His saying «واختلاف»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to {خَلْقِكُمْ}; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, by conjunction to «اختلاف»; the preposition phrase «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أَنزل»; the preposition phrase «من رزق» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «آيات» is a noun conjoined to «آيات» in the previous verse. This is a case of conjunction to [the objects of] two governors, and it is permissible: that is, «اختلاف» is conjoined to {خَلْقِكُمْ}, which is governed by «في», and the second «آيات» is conjoined to the first «آيات», which is governed by inception (al-ibtidāʾ).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «نتلوها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آيات»; the preposition phrase «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «نتلو»; and the clause «يؤمنون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نتلوها عليك بالحق».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «ويل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «لكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «يسمع» is a naʿt (adjective) of {أَفَّاكٍ}; the clause «تتلى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آيات»; «مستكبرا» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يصرُّ»; «كأن» is lightened from the heavy one, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «لم يسمعها» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأن»; the clause «كأن لم يسمعها» is a second ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يصرُّ»; and the clause «فبشِّره» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا}; the preposition phrase «من آياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «شيئا»; «هزوا» is a second object; the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك», and the clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «من ورائهم جهنم» is a second khabar (predicate) of {أُولَئِكَ}; the clause «ولا يغني عنهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «من ورائهم جهنم»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «يغني», i.e.: and their earning will not avail them «شيئاً», [which is] a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the second «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar «ما اتخذوا» is conjoined to the first maṣdar, the implied form being: and neither their earning nor their taking will avail them. The preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أولياء»; and the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause {لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ} in verse (9).

mekki-muskil:4-4.t:
His saying, the Exalted, {آيَات لقوم يوقنون} and آيات لقوم يعقلون: whoever read آياتٍ in both places with kasra on the tāʾ (i.e. accusative) conjoined it to the wording of the ism (noun) of إنّ in His saying {إِن فِي السَّمَاوَات وَالْأَرْض لآيَات}, and you assume the omission of في from His saying, the Exalted, {وَاخْتِلَاف اللَّيْل وَالنَّهَار}, i.e. "and in the alternation of night and day". في is omitted because it has been mentioned before, in His saying, the Exalted, {إِن فِي السَّمَاوَات وَالْأَرْض} and in His saying, the Exalted, {وَفِي خَلقكُم}; since it had come twice before, He dropped it with the third because of its prior mention. By this, the accusative in the last آيات is sound. If you do not assume this omission, you will have conjoined to two different governors (ʿāmilān), and that is not permissible according to the Basrans. The two governors are إنّ, which puts in the accusative, and في, which puts in the genitive; so you would be conjoining with the wāw to two governors differing in inflection, one putting in the accusative and one in the genitive. If you assume the omission of في because of its prior mention, all that remains is that you conjoin to a single governor, and that is good. Some of the Kufans made it a case of conjunction to two governors and did not assume the omission of في; that is far-fetched.

On the assumption of omission in cases like this verse, Sībawayh cited:
.. أكلَّ امرئٍ تحسبين امرأً ... ونارٍ توقَّدُ بالليل نارا ...
("Do you reckon every man a (true) man, and every fire kindled at night a (true) fire?")
He put ونارٍ in the genitive and the last نارا in the accusative, conjoining it to كلّ, which is accusative by تحسبين, and to امرئ, which is genitive by كلّ; so he conjoined to two different governors. Sībawayh took its implied form as the omission of كلّ with نار because of its prior mention, as though he said "and every fire"; then كلّ was dropped because of its prior mention. By this implied form he is saved from conjunction to two governors. Dropping a preposition when it has been mentioned before is permissible; on that basis Sībawayh allowed مررت برجل صالح إلا صالحٍ فصالحٍ, meaning "except with (بصالح) a righteous one", then the bāʾ was dropped because of its prior mention.

[Translator's note: Sībawayh's example is usually given as «إلّا صالحٍ فطالحٍ» ("if not a righteous one, then a wicked one"); the printed text has «فصالح».]

It has also been said that His saying واختلاف الليل is conjoined to السماوات, and آيات is accusative by repetition (takrīr), since the speech had grown long after the first; it was repeated in both (places) because the speech had grown long, just as you say ما زيدٌ قائما ولا جالسا زيدٌ: you put جالسا in the accusative on the view that the last زيد is the first one, but you made it overt a second time for emphasis. Had the last been other than the first, the accusative of جالس would not be permissible, because the khabar (predicate) of ما does not come before its ism, since it is not inflected (not a full verb); it is unlike ليس in this. Likewise the last آيات is the first, but it was made overt for emphasis since the speech had grown long, so on this implied form conjunction to two governors is not entailed. So understand it.

As for whoever put آيات in the nominative in both places, he conjoined that to the position of إنّ and what it governs; and the position of إنّ and what it governs is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), because it enters only upon a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. So he put it in the nominative and conjoined it to the position before إنّ entered. Yet في must be implied, otherwise conjunction to two governors would enter it here too: to the mubtadaʾ (as governor) and to the genitive (preposition). The Basrans have forbidden زيد في الدار والحجرةِ عمرو with الحجرة in the genitive. It is also possible that he put it in the nominative only by way of cutting off (qaṭʿ) and starting anew, thus conjoining a clause to a clause. The school of al-Akhfash is that الآيات is nominative by the (implied) "being settled" (istiqrār), which is the ẓarf, so conjunction to two governors does not enter into it.

His saying {قل للَّذين آمنُوا يغفروا للَّذين}: it is jussive, construed according to the sense, because the meaning is "say to them: forgive, (and) they will forgive". This has been mentioned before more fully than here.

[Translator's note: قل للذين آمنوا يغفروا is in āya 14, though it is printed under this entry.]

mekki-muskil:8-8.t: His saying {ثمَّ يصر مستكبرا}: it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent nominative pronoun in يصرّ. Likewise the position of His saying كأن لم يسمعها and His saying كأن في أذنيه وقرا: both are also ḥāls, from the latent pronoun in يصرّ and from the latent pronoun in مستكبر. Its implied form is "then he persists in disbelief in the signs of Allah in a state of arrogance and a state of feigning deafness". If you wish, you take its implied form as "then he persists, arrogant, resembling one who has not heard them, resembling one in whose ears is deafness".

mekki-muskil:21-21.t:
His saying {سَاءَ مَا يحكمون}: if you make مَا definite, it is in the nominative position, governed by ساء as its fāʿil (agent); if you make it indefinite, it is in the accusative position as specification (bayān, i.e. tamyīz).

His saying {سَوَاء محياهم ومماتهم}: سواء is the khabar (predicate) of what follows it, and محياهم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "their living and their dying are equal", i.e. alike in remoteness from Allah's mercy. The two pronouns in محياهم and مماتهم are for the disbelievers, so it is not good for the clause to be in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين آمنوا, since there is nothing referring back to them in their ḥāl. It is far-fetched, according to Sībawayh, to put محياهم in the nominative by سواء, because it is not an active participle nor does it resemble an active participle; it is only a maṣdar (verbal noun).

As for whoever put سواءً in the accusative, he made it a ḥāl from the hāʾ and mīm in نجعلهم and put محياهم ومماتهم in the nominative by it, because it is in the sense of مستوٍ ("equal"). The second object of جعل is then the kāf in كالذين, and the two pronouns in محياهم and مماتهم refer to the disbelievers and the believers. There is room for consideration in this.

[Translator's note: the source has «تجعله» for the Quranic «نجعلهم».]

mekki-muskil:22-22.t: His saying {وَخلق الله السَّمَاوَات وَالْأَرْض بِالْحَقِّ}: بالحق is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the bāʾ is not for making (the verb) transitive.

mekki-muskil:23-23.t: His saying {فَمن يهديه}: من is an interrogative, nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and what follows it is its khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:25-25.t: His saying {مَا كَانَ حجتهم إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا}: أن is in the nominative position as the ism (noun) of كان, and حجتهم the khabar (predicate). It is also permissible to put حجتهم in the nominative and make أن be in the accusative position as the khabar of كان.

mekki-muskil:27-27.t: His saying {وَيَوْم تقوم السَّاعَة يَوْمئِذٍ يخسر المبطلون}: the first يوم is accusative, governed by يخسر, and يومئذ is a repetition for emphasis.

mekki-muskil:29-29.t: His saying {ينْطق عَلَيْكُم}: in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الكتاب or from ذا. It may be a second khabar (predicate) of ذا; and it is possible that كتابنا is a badal (substitute) for هذا and ينطق the khabar.

mekki-muskil:32-32.t:
His saying {والساعة لَا ريب فِيهَا}: الساعة is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), or by conjunction to the position of إنّ and what it governs. Whoever put الساعة in the accusative conjoined it to وعد.

His saying {إِن نظن إِلَّا ظنا}: its implied form according to al-Mubarrad is "we are not except (that) we think a thinking". It has also been said that the meaning is "we do not think except that you are thinking a thinking". This implied form was needed only because the benefit of the maṣdar (verbal noun) is like the benefit of the verb; had the speech run without omission, its implied form would be "we do not think except we think", and this is deficient speech. The grammarians did not allow ما ضربت إلا ضربا, because its meaning is "I did not strike except I struck", and this is speech with no benefit in it.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿حم﴾: the discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم﴾: «تنزيل» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «الكتاب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «من الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and «العزيز الحكيم» are two naʿts (adjectives) of «الله». Or «تنزيل» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and «من الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿إن في السماوات والأرض﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿لآيات للمؤمنين﴾: the lām is for emphasis; «آيات» is the noun of «إن»; and «للمؤمنين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «آيات».

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وفي خلقكم وما يبث من دابة آيات لقوم يوقنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «في خلقكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «خلقكم», in the position of a genitive (majrūr); «يبث» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause «يبث» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «من دابة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يبث», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: He disperses it, being of creatures; «آيات» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «لقوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «آيات»; «يوقنون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause «يوقنون» is an adjective of «قوم».

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿واختلاف الليل والنهار وما أنزل الله من السماء من رزق فأحيا به الأرض بعد موتها وتصريف الرياح آيات لقوم يعقلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «اختلاف» is also conjoined to «خَلْقِكُم», taking its place in being attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); «الليل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «النهار» is conjoined to «الليل», genitive (majrūr); «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «اختلاف»; «أنزل الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «أنزل الله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position. «من السماء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أنزل»; «من رزق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to «أنزل». «فأحيا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أحيا» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أحيا»; «الأرض» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بعد» is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb, attached to «أحيا»; «موتها» is muḍāf ilayhi, and «ها» is muḍāf ilayhi; «تصريف» is conjoined to «اختلاف»; «الرياح» is muḍāf ilayhi; «آيات» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «لقوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective; «يعقلون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause «يعقلون» is an adjective of «قوم».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿تلك آيات الله نتلوها عليك بالحق﴾: «تلك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «آيات» is the khabar (predicate); the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «نتلوها» is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and «ها» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «نتلوها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. Or «آيات» is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative, and the clause «نتلوها» is the khabar. «عليك»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نتلوها»; «بالحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: clothed with the truth.
[Translator's note: the wāw in «نتلوها» is the final radical of the verb, not a pronoun; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as «نحن». Translated as written.]
﴿فبأي حديث بعد الله وآياته يؤمنون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «بأي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنون»; «حديث» is muḍāf ilayhi; «بعد» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «حديث»; the word of majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; «يؤمنون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿ويل لكل أفاك أثيم﴾: «ويل» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «لكل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); «أفاك» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «أثيم» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿يسمع آيات الله تتلى عليه﴾: the clause «يسمع» is an adjective of «أفاك أثيم», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «أثيم», or resumptive, with no grammatical position. «يسمع آيات» is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the word of majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «تتلى» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause «تتلى» is a ḥāl from «آيات»; and «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تتلى».
﴿ثم يصر مستكبرا﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence and delay; «يصر» is an imperfect verb conjoined to «يسمع»; and «مستكبرًا» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يصر».
﴿كأن لم يسمعها فبشره بعذاب أليم﴾: «كأن» is lightened from the heavy [form] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion [to the past] and jussive; «يسمعها» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause «لم يسمعها» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأن», and the clause is a second ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وإذا علم من آياتنا شيئا اتخذها هزوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb of future time (ẓarf mustaqbal) containing the meaning of condition; «علم» is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause «علم» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «من آياتنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «علم», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of «شيئًا» and was placed before it; «نا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «شيئًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «اتخذها» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; «اتخذها» is a past verb, the fāʿil is latent, «ها» is the first object of «اتخذ», and «هزوًا» is the second object of «اتخذ».
﴿أولئك لهم عذاب مهين﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); «عذاب» is the postponed mubtadaʾ; «مهين» is an adjective of «عذاب»; the clause is the khabar of «أولئك», and the clause «أولئك» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿من ورائهم جهنم﴾: «من ورائهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «جهنم» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولا يغني عنهم ما كسبوا شيئا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is negative; «يغني» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); «عنهم»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يغني»; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); «كسبوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «كسبوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or «ما» is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the fāʿil of «يغني». «شيئًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يغني».
﴿ولا ما اتخذوا من دون الله أولياء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is a connective (ṣila) [particle] for emphasising the negation; «ما» is a relative noun, conjoined, nominative; «اتخذوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «اتخذوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or «ما» is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar, conjoined, nominative. «من دون» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of «أولياء»; the word of majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; «أولياء» is the second object of «اتخذوا», and the first object is omitted, i.e.: they took it.
﴿ولهم عذاب عظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; «عذاب» is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and «عظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿هذا هدى والذين كفروا بآيات ربهم لهم عذاب من رجز أليم﴾: «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «هدى» is the khabar (predicate); the wāw is a conjunction; «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ; «كفروا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «بآيات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كفروا»; «ربهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; «عذاب» is the postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of «الذين»; «من رجز» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «عذاب»; and «أليم» is an adjective of «رجز».

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿الله الذي سخر لكم البحر لتجري الفلك فيه بأمره﴾: «الله»: the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الذي» is its khabar (predicate); «سخر» is a verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause «سخر» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سخر»; «البحر» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); «تجري» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to «سخر»; «الفلك» is the fāʿil; «بأمره» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الفلك», and the hāʾ is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is causal; «تبتغوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the causal lām, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to «سخر»; «من فضله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تبتغوا»; the wāw is a conjunction; «لعلكم تشكرون»: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) expressing hope (tarajjī), «كم» is its noun, and the clause «تشكرون» is its khabar; «تشكرون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وسخر لكم ما في السماوات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «سخر» is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سخر»; «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما في الأرض جميعا منه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما في الأرض» is conjoined to «ما في السماوات»; «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما»; and «منه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «جميعا».
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يتفكرون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «في ذلك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); «آيات» is the postponed noun of «إن»; «لقوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «آيات»; «يتفكرون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause «يتفكرون» is an adjective of «قوم».

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿قل للذين آمنوا يغفروا للذين لا يرجون أيام الله﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «للذين»: the lām is a preposition, and «الذين» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قل»; «آمنوا» is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «يغفروا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by an implied lām of command; the deletion of the lām is permissible because «قُل» indicates the command; and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.
Or: «يغفروا» is an imperfect verb, jussive as the answer to the imperative «قُل», and the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, the implied form being: say to those who believe, "Forgive", [and] they will forgive.
Or: «يغفروا» is an imperfect verb turned from command to statement, its meaning being «اغفروا», and it was made indeclinable (mabnī) because it occurs in the place of an indeclinable [form], so its nūn was deleted.
«للذين»: the lām is a preposition, and «الذين» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يغفروا»; «لا» is negative; «يرجون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; «أيام» is the object of «يرجون»; the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause «لا يرجون» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ليجزي قوما بما كانوا يكسبون﴾: «ليجزي»: the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl), and «يجزي» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the causal lām; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring to Allah; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied «أن» and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قل»; «قومًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يجزي»; the clause «كانوا يكسبون» is the ṣila of «ما», with no grammatical position. Or «ما» is maṣdariyya, and it together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يجزي». «كانوا»: «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; «يكسبون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; and the clause «يكسبون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿من عمل صالحا فلنفسه ومن أساء فعليها ثم إلى ربكم ترجعون﴾: «من» is conditional, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «عمل» is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «صالحًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «عمل», or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e.: he did a righteous deed. The fāʾ is the one occurring in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «لنفسه» is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "his deed" (عمله); the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis. «من أساء» is conjoined to the preceding clause, parallel to it in i'rab. «ثم» is a conjunction; «إلى ربكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترجعون»; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; «ترجعون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿ولقد آتينا بني إسرائيل الكتاب والحكم والنبوة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «آتينا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «بني» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إسرائيل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الكتاب» is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause «ولقد آتينا...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «والحكم والنبوة»: two conjoined [nouns], accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa.
﴿ورزقناهم من الطيبات وفضلناهم على العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «رزقناهم» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; «من الطيبات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رزقناهم»; «فضلناهم» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; and «على العالمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «فضلنا».

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿وآتيناهم بينات من الأمر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «آتيناهم» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بينات» is the second mafʿūl bihi, the sign of its accusative being the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural; and «من الأمر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of «بينات».
﴿فما اختلفوا إلا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ما» is negative; «اختلفوا» is a verb and its fāʿil; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «من بعد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «اختلفوا»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is genitive by annexation; «جاءهم العلم»: a verb; the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and «العلم» is a postponed fāʿil; «بغيًا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and «بينهم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted adjective of «بغيًا».
﴿إن ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «رب» is its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «يقضي» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause «يقضي» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «بينهم» is an adverb attached to «يقضي»; «يوم» is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «القيامة» is muḍāf ilayhi; «فيما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to «يقضي»; the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause «يختلفون» is the khabar of «كان»; «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يختلفون»; «يختلفون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
[Translator's note: «كان» in "the khabar of «كان»" for «يقضي» appears to be a slip for «إن»; translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ثم جعلناك على شريعة من الأمر فاتبعها﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction; «جعلناك» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «على شريعة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object; «من الأمر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «شريعة»; the fāʾ is a conjunction; and «اتبعها» is an imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا تتبع أهواء الذين لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive; «تتبع» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); «أهواء» is the mafʿūl bihi; «الذين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «لا» is negative; «يعلمون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause «لا يعلمون» is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿إنهم لن يغنوا عنك من الله شيئا﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, and the clause «لن يغنوا» is its khabar (predicate); «لن» is a particle of negation and accusative; «يغنوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «عنك»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يغنوا»; «من الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to «يغنوا»; and «شيئًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وإن الظالمين بعضهم أولياء بعض والله ولي المتقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is an abrogating particle, and «الظالمين» is its noun; «بعضهم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «أولياء» is the khabar; «بعض» is muḍāf ilayhi; and the nominal clause is the khabar of «إن». «الله» is a mubtadaʾ, «ولي» is the khabar, and «المتقين» is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿هذا بصائر للناس وهدى ورحمة لقوم يوقنون﴾: «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «بصائر» is its khabar (predicate); «للناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of «بصائر»; «وهدى ورحمة»: two conjoined [nouns], nominative (marfūʿ); «لقوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause «يوقنون» is a naʿt of «قوم»; «يوقنون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the whole clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿أم حسب الذين اجترحوا السيئات أن نجعلهم كالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: «أم» is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل» plus the hamza, i.e.: nay, do they think …?; «حسب» is a past verb, and «الذين» is its fāʿil (agent); «اجترحوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «اجترحوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «أن» and what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that stands in place of the two objects of «حسب»; «أن» is a maṣdar-forming particle of the accusative; «نجعلهم» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); the hāʾ is the first object of «نجعل»; «كالذين»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the second object, i.e.: that We make them like those who believed; «الذين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «آمنوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the wāw is a conjunction; and «عملوا الصالحات» is a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿سواء محياهم ومماتهم﴾: «سواء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «محياهم» is the fāʿil of «سواء», and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi. «ومماتهم» is conjoined to «محياهم».
﴿ساء ما يحكمون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «ساء» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable on fatḥa; the fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent, its implied form being «هو», referring to their false reckoning. «ما» is an indefinite described [noun] (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of an accusative, tamyīz (specification) of the fāʿil of «ساء»; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: their judgement. The clause «يحكمون» is in the position of an accusative, a naʿt (adjective) of «ما», the implied form being: evil is a judgement that they make.
Or «ما» is a relative noun meaning «الذي», in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil of «ساء», and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e.: their judgement. The clause «يحكمون» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
Or «ما» is maṣdariyya. The clause «يحكمون» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «ما», with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar from «ما» and what it governs is the fāʿil of «ساء», the implied form being: evil is their judgement. And the one specified for blame is omitted.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وخلق الله السماوات والأرض بالحق﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «خلق الله السماوات» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الأرض» is conjoined to «السماوات»; the clause «وخلق الله...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and «بالحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil or the object.
﴿ولتجزى كل نفس بما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); «تجزى» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خلق»; «كل» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); «نفس» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تجزى»; the clause «كسبت» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or «ما» is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تجزى». «كسبت» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). The wāw is circumstantial; «هم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «لا» is negative; «يظلمون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «لا يظلمون» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.
[Translator's note: «يظلمون» here is passive (يُظلَمون), so its wāw would normally be called the nāʾib fāʿil; translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿أفرأيت من اتخذ إلهه هواه وأضله الله على علم﴾: the hamza is for an interrogative intended as a command, i.e.: tell me; «رأيت» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «من» is the first object of «رأيت», and the second is omitted, its implied form being "guided" (مهتديًا); the clause «اتخذ» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «اتخذ» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); «إلهه» is the first object of «اتخذ», and «هواه» is its second object; the wāw is a conjunction; «أضله الله» is a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil; and «على علم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object.
﴿وختم على سمعه وقلبه وجعل على بصره غشاوة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ختم» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent; «على سمعه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ختم»; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «قلبه» is conjoined to «سمعه»; «جعل» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent; «على بصره» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «جعل»; and «غشاوة» is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فمن يهديه من بعد الله أفلا تذكرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «من» is an interrogative noun with the sense of negation, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «يهديه» is the khabar (predicate); «يهديه» is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; «من بعد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يهديه»; the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is muḍāf ilayhi; the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is conjoining to something omitted and implied, i.e.: do you persist in error and not take heed?; «لا» is negative; «تذكرون» is an imperfect verb from which one of its two tāʾs has been deleted, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿وقالوا ما هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «ما» is negative; «هي» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «حياتنا» is the khabar (predicate), and «نا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الدنيا» is a naʿt (adjective), nominative (marfūʿ); the clause «وقالوا ما هي...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «نموت» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause «نموت» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw is a conjunction; and «نحيا» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent.
﴿وما يهلكنا إلا الدهر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negative; «يهلكنا» is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إلا» is a particle of restriction; and «الدهر» is the fāʿil of «يهلكنا».
﴿وما لهم بذلك من علم إن هم إلا يظنون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «ما» is negative; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar; «بذلك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «علم»; «من» is a connective (ṣila) preposition; «علم» is the postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative in position, genitive (majrūr) in form by «مِن»; «إن» is negative; «هم» is a mubtadaʾ; «إلا» is a particle of restriction; the clause «يظنون» is the khabar of «هم»; «يظنون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb of future time (ẓarf mustaqbal) containing the meaning of condition; the clause «تتلى» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «تتلى» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive); «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تتلى»; «آياتنا» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «نا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ما كان حجتهم إلا أن قالوا ائتوا بآبائنا إن كنتم صادقين﴾: «ما» is negative; «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb; «حجتهم» is the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «أن» is a maṣdar-forming particle; «قالوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and what it governs is the postponed noun of «كان». The clause «ما كان حجتهم» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. «ائتوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «بآبائنا»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ائتوا»; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). «إن» is a jussive conditional particle; «كنتم» is a deficient past verb in the position of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being «فائتوا»; the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», and «صادقين» is the khabar of «كنتم».

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قل الله يحييكم ثم يميتكم ثم يجمعكم إلى يوم القيامة لا ريب فيه﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يحييكم» is the khabar (predicate); «يحييكم» is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «ثم» is a conjunction; «يميتكم» is an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; «ثم» is a conjunction; «يجمعكم» is an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; «إلى يوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يجمعكم»; «القيامة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «ريب» is its noun; «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of «لا»; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «يوم القيامة».
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لكنَّ» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «أكثرهم» is its noun; «الناس» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «لا يعلمون» is the khabar of «لكن»; «لا» is negative; «يعلمون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
[Translator's note: the ayah reads «أكثر الناس»; «أكثرهم» in the source appears to be carried over from a similar ayah. Translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ولله ملك السماوات والأرض﴾: «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); «ملك» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «السماوات» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «الأرض» is conjoined to «السماوات», genitive (majrūr).
﴿ويوم تقوم الساعة يومئذ يخسر المبطلون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «يخسر»; the clause «تقوم» is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; «تقوم الساعة» is an imperfect verb and a nominative (marfūʿ) fāʿil (agent); «يومئذ»: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to «يخسر», and it is an emphasis (tawkīd) of the preceding adverb or a badal (substitute) from it; «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for a clause, the implied form being: on the day when the Hour is established. «يخسر المبطلون» is a verb and its fāʿil; and the clause «ويوم تقوم الساعة...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وترى كل أمة جاثية كل أمة تدعى إلى كتابها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ترى» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «كل» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if the seeing is cognitive (ʿilmiyya), but the context of the speech favours its being visual (baṣariyya); «أمة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «جاثية» is the second mafʿūl bihi on the first view, and a ḥāl (circumstantial) on the second view. «كل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «أمة» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «تدعى إلى كتابها» is the khabar (predicate); «تدعى» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; «إلى كتابها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تدعى»; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿اليوم تجزون ما كنتم تعملون﴾: «اليوم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «تجزون»; «تجزون» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; «ما» is the second mafʿūl bihi of «تجزون»; the clause is the speech reported by an omitted verb of saying, i.e.: it will be said to them: "Today you are recompensed". «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause «تعملون» is its khabar; «تعملون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «كنتم تعملون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿هذا كتابنا ينطق عليكم بالحق﴾: «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «كتابنا» is the khabar (predicate), and «نا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «ينطق» is a second khabar, or in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the khabar; or «كتابنا» is a badal (substitute) from «هذا», and the clause «ينطق» is the khabar of «هذا». «ينطق» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينطق»; and «بالحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿إنا كنا نستنسخ ما كنتم تعملون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «نا» is its noun; the clause «كنا» is the khabar of «إن»; «كنا»: «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and «نا» is its noun; the clause «نستنسخ» is the khabar of «كان»; «نستنسخ» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «كنتم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position. «كنتم»: «كان» is a deficient past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause «تعملون» is the khabar of «كان»; «تعملون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿فأما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فيدخلهم ربهم في رحمته﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أما» is a particle of condition, detailing and emphasis; «الذين» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «آمنوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the wāw is a conjunction; «عملوا الصالحات» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «فيدخلهم»: the fāʾ links the answer of «أما»; «يدخلهم ربهم» is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «في رحمته» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يدخل»; and the clause «يدخلهم ربهم في رحمته» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين».
﴿ذلك هو الفوز المبين﴾: «ذلك» is the mubtadaʾ; «هو» is a second mubtadaʾ, and «الفوز» is the khabar of «هو»; the clause made of the second mubtadaʾ and its khabar is the khabar of the demonstrative. Or «هو» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and «الفوز» is the khabar of the demonstrative; and «المبين» is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وأما الذين كفروا أفلم تكن آياتي تتلى عليكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أما» is a particle of condition, detailing and emphasis; «الذين» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «كفروا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the answer of «أما» is omitted, its implied form being «فيقال لهم» (then it will be said to them). The hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ conjoins to the omitted answer; «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion [to the past] and jussive; «تكن» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم»; «آياتي» is the noun of «تكن», and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «تتلى عليكم» is the khabar (predicate) of «تكن»; «تتلى» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); and «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تتلى».
﴿فاستكبرتم وكنتم قوما مجرمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «استكبرتم» is a verb and its fāʿil; the wāw is a conjunction; «كنتم»: «كان» is a deficient past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «قومًا» is its khabar, and «مجرمين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومًا».

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وإذا قيل إن وعد الله حق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb of future time (ẓarf mustaqbal) containing the meaning of condition; «قيل» is a past verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «وعد» is its noun, the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), «حق» is its khabar (predicate), and the word of majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿والساعة لا ريب فيها قلتم ما ندري ما الساعة﴾: «الساعة» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «لا ريب فيها» is its khabar; it has also been said: «الساعة» is conjoined to the position of the noun of «إن», because before «إن» entered on it, it was nominative (marfūʿ) by inception (ibtidāʾ). «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «ريب» is its noun; «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of «لا». The clause «قلتم» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; «قلتم» is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); «ما» is negative; «ندري» is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ, and «الساعة» is its khabar.
﴿إن نظن إلا ظنا وما نحن بمستيقنين﴾: «إن» is negative; «نظن» is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «ظنًّا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative «ما», which operates like «ليس»; «نحن» is the noun of «ما»; «بمستيقنين»: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and «مستيقنين» is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī «ما», accusative (manṣūb) in position, genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿وبدا لهم سيئات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «بدا» is a past verb; «لهم»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بدا»; «سيئات» is the fāʿil (agent); «ما» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «عملوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position. Or «ما» is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by annexation. «عملوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause «وبدا لهم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «وحاق»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «حاق» is a past verb; «بهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «حاق»; «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil of «حاق»; the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «كانوا»: «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يستهزئون»; the clause «يستهزئون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا»; and «يستهزئون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وقيل اليوم ننساكم كما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قيل» is a past verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive); «اليوم» is an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ننساكم»; «كما»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative, an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); «ما» is maṣdariyya, and it together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «نسيتم» is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); «لقاء» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يومكم» is muḍāf ilayhi, and it is itself a muḍāf, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; «هذا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يومكم», and it is an underived (jāmid) word interpreted as a derived one, i.e.: the one pointed to.
﴿ومأواكم النار وما لكم من ناصرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «مأواكم» is a fronted khabar (predicate), and «النار» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), or the reverse; the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negative; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; «من» is a connective (ṣila) preposition; and «ناصرين» is genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, as the postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿ذلكم بأنكم اتخذتم آيات الله هزوا﴾: «ذلكم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «بأنكم»: the bāʾ is a preposition; «أن» is a maṣdar-forming particle of the accusative; the kāf is its noun, and the clause «اتخذتم» is its khabar (predicate); «أن» and what falls within its scope is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of «ذلكم»; «اتخذتم» is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); «آيات» is the first object of «اتخذتم»; the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «هزوًا» is the second object of «اتخذتم».
﴿وغرتكم الحياة الدنيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «غرتكم» is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الحياة» is a postponed fāʿil; and «الدنيا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة».
﴿فاليوم لا يخرجون منها ولا هم يستعتبون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «اليوم» is an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to «يخرجون»; «لا» is negative; «يخرجون» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «منها»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يخرجون»; the clause «فاليوم لا يخرجون منها» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is negative; «هم» is the mubtadaʾ; the clause «يستعتبون» is the khabar; and «يستعتبون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
[Translator's note: «يستعتبون» is passive (يُستعتَبون), so its wāw would normally be called the nāʾib fāʿil; translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿فلله الحمد رب السماوات ورب الأرض رب العالمين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); «الحمد» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «فلله الحمد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «رب» is a badal (substitute) or naʿt (adjective) of «لله»; «السماوات» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is a conjunction; «رب الأرض» is conjoined to «رب السماوات»; and «رب العالمين» is a badal from «رب السماوات».

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وله الكبرياء في السماوات والأرض وهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). «الكبرياء» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكبرياء», or attached to the omitted khabar, or attached to «الكبرياء», because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun). «هو» is a mubtadaʾ; «العزيز» is the first khabar, and «الحكيم» is the second khabar.

nahhas-irab:29-29.t: هذا كِتابُنا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ «ينطق» (speaks) is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); it may also be in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of هذا, with «كتابنا» a badal (substitute) for هذا.

nahhas-irab:30-30.t: الَّذِينَ is in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ.

nahhas-irab:31-31.t: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا: الَّذِينَ is likewise in the position of a nominative. The verb of saying has been omitted, as it is very often omitted in the speech of the Arabs, and when it was omitted the fāʾ was omitted along with it, because it is subordinate to it. [Translator's note: i.e. the implied form is "then it will be said to them: Were not My verses recited to you…?"] فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ: al-istikbār (arrogance) in the language is disdain at following the truth. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has made this clear on the tongue of His Messenger ﷺ when he was asked, "What is arrogance (al-kibr)?" — as was read out to Isḥāq ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Yūnus, from Muḥammad ibn al-Muthannā, from ʿAbd al-Wahhāb, from Hishām, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayra: "A man came to the Prophet ﷺ — he was a handsome man — and said: O Messenger of Allah, beauty has been made dear to me, and I have been given of it what you see, so much so that I do not like anyone to surpass me — either he said: in the strap of a sandal, or he said: in a sandal-thong. Is that part of arrogance? He said: No; rather, arrogance is disdaining the truth (baṭar al-ḥaqq) and belittling people (ghamṣ al-nās)." Isḥāq said: And al-Walīd ibn Shujāʿ narrated to us, saying: ʿAṭāʾ ibn Muslim al-Khaffāf narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "The arrogant will be gathered — I think he said — in the forms of small ants." Isḥāq said: And Muḥammad ibn Bakkār narrated to us, saying: Ismāʿīl — meaning Ibn ʿUlayya — narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from al-Agharr, from Abū Hurayra: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: Grandeur (al-kibriyāʾ) is My cloak and majesty is My wrapper; whoever contends with Me over either of them, I shall cast him into Hell."

nahhas-irab:32-32.t:
وَإِذا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لا رَيْبَ فِيها: al-Aʿmash and Ḥamza read السَّاعَةُ لا رَيْبَ فِيها as a conjoined (maʿṭūf) form, meaning "and that the Hour — there is no doubt about it". [Translator's note: the text as printed vocalizes the word with ḍamma; the reading of Ḥamza is in fact وَالسَّاعَةَ in the accusative, conjoined to وَعْدَ اللَّهِ, which is what "conjoined" here refers to.] The nominative is by being mubtadaʾ (subject); it may also be conjoined to the position [of إنّ and its noun], i.e. "and it was said: the Hour — there is no doubt about it"; and the clause may be in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). Abū ʿUbayd claimed that whoever reads with the nominative here is obliged to read [likewise] وَكَتَبْنا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيها أَنَّ النَّفْسَ بِالنَّفْسِ وَالْعَيْنَ بِالْعَيْنِ [al-Māʾida: 45]. This is an attack on the body of those whose authority is decisive, for among those whose reading constitutes authority there are some who read it with the nominative here and with the accusative there: among them Nāfiʿ and ʿĀṣim, who read وَالسَّاعَةُ لا رَيْبَ فِيها and read «والعين بالعين» with the accusative, and likewise what follows it. It is also an attack on ʿAbd Allāh ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ, Abū Jaʿfar the Reader and ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir, because they read «والساعة لا ريب فيها» and read وَالْعَيْنَ بِالْعَيْنِ with the accusative, and likewise what follows it, except «والجروح قصاص». And the ḥadīth narrated from the Prophet ﷺ that he read «والعين بالعين» cannot be in the position of a ḥāl. [Translator's note: this sentence appears to be defective in the source; the intended sense seems to be that the ḥadīth reports the Prophet ﷺ reading «والعينُ بالعينِ» with the nominative, and that the nominative there cannot be taken as a ḥāl, unlike in the present verse.] Abū ʿUbayd mentioned that its parallel is وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ [Luqmān: 27], but that differs from it, because for وَالْبَحْرُ the most fitting analysis, according to the grammarians, is that it be in the position of a ḥāl, whereas the most far-fetched analysis of «الساعة لا ريب فيها» is that it be in the position of a ḥāl.
قُلْتُمْ ما نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِنْ نَظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا: this is among the difficult and obscure points of i'rab, because one does not say "mā ḍarabtu illā ḍarban" (I did not strike except a striking) or "mā ẓanantu illā ẓannan" (I did not think except a thinking), since there is no benefit in its occurring after the particle of affirmation (illā), for the meaning of the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the same as the meaning of the verb. The answer concerning the verse, from Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad], takes two forms. One is that there is a fronting and postponing in the speech, i.e. "in naḥnu illā naẓunnu ẓannan" (we are nothing but [people who] think a thinking); he claimed that its parallel in the speech of the Arabs, reported by Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ and Sībawayh, is "laysa al-ṭību illā al-misku" (there is no perfume but musk), i.e. "laysa illā al-ṭību al-misku". The other answer is that the implied form is: "we think nothing except that you are thinking a [mere] thinking".

nahhas-irab:33-35.t:
Abū al-ʿAbbās said: وَحاقَ بِهِمْ means "befell them".
ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās concerning الْيَوْمَ نَنْساكُمْ: he said: "We abandon you." كَما نَسِيتُمْ لِقاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هذا may be from forgetting, i.e. you busied yourselves away from the Day of Resurrection with your pleasures and the affairs of your worldly life, so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, rebuked them for that. The meaning may also be: just as you abandoned working for the meeting of this Day of yours.
Its literal sense in Arabic is: just as you abandoned the work of the meeting of this Day of yours, like وَسْئَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ [Yūsuf: 82] [Translator's note: i.e. a muḍāf (here "work") has been omitted, as "the people of" is omitted before الْقَرْيَةَ].

nahhas-irab:36-36.t: As a badal (substitute); it may also be a naʿt (adjective). [Translator's note: the word referred to is not quoted in the source; it is evidently رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ in relation to what precedes it in the verse فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّماواتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ.]

nahhas-irab:37-37.t: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِياءُ فِي السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd said: al-kibriyāʾ is majesty and grandeur. وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate).

nahhas-irab:1-2.t: (تَنْزِيلُ) is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is (مِنَ اللَّهِ). It may also be nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, that is, "this is the sending down of the Book"; and it may be nominative as the khabar of «حم». (الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ): a naʿt (adjective), and it carries the meaning of praise.

nahhas-irab:3-3.t: (لَآياتٍ) is in the position of the accusative; the tāʾ has a kasra because it is a sound plural, so that the feminine agrees with the masculine in the accusative and genitive being alike. The tāʾ, according to Sībawayh, is in the standing of the yāʾ and the wāw [of the masculine sound plural]; according to others, the kasra is in the standing of the yāʾ; and it was said: the tāʾ and the kasra [together] are in the standing of the yāʾ, while the alif is an addition to distinguish between singular and plural.

nahhas-irab:4-5.t:
(وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَما يَبُثُّ مِنْ دابَّةٍ آياتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ): this is the reading of the Medinans [and] Abū ʿAmr, and likewise the one after it. Al-Aʿmash, Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read «آياتٍ» with the genitive ending, in the position of the accusative, and likewise the one after it. Al-Kisāʾī argued for this reading that in the codex (ḥarf) of Ubayy it is «لآيات» in all of them, with the lām; he took this as proof that it is conjoined to what precedes it. Al-Farrāʾ said: in the reading of ʿAbd Allāh [ibn Masʿūd] it is «وفي اختلاف اللّيل والنّهار», with «في» in it. Abū ʿUbayd's choice is what al-Kisāʾī chose.
Abū Jaʿfar said: As for His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَما يَبُثُّ مِنْ دابَّةٍ آياتٌ, there is no disagreement among the grammarians that the accusative and the nominative are both good. The accusative is by conjunction, that is: "and [indeed] in your creation…". The nominative is from three ways. One of them: that it is conjoined to the position, like وَإِذا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لا رَيْبَ فِيها. The second way: the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) with its khabar (predicate), a clause conjoined to a clause, cut off from the first, as you say: إنّ زيدا خارج وأنا أجيئك غدا ("Zayd is going out, and I shall come to you tomorrow"). The third way: that the clause be in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), like يَغْشى طائِفَةً مِنْكُمْ وَطائِفَةٌ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ [Āl ʿImrān: 154].
As for His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: وَاخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ وَما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّماءِ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَأَحْيا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِها وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّياحِ آياتٌ, the grammarians disagreed about it. Some of them said: the accusative in it is permissible, and they permitted conjunction upon two governing words. Among those who said this are Sībawayh, al-Akhfash, al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ. Sībawayh recited [metre: al-mutaqārib], verse 416:
أكلّ امرئ تحسبين امرأ ... ونار توقّد باللّيل نارا
(Do you reckon every person a [true] man, and every fire kindled at night a [hospitable] fire?)
Some of them rejected this and did not permit conjunction upon two governing words, saying: whoever conjoins upon two governing words would permit «في الدار زيد والحجرة عمرو» ("Zayd is in the house, and ʿAmr the room"). Whoever holds this view recites «ونارا» in the accusative, and says that whoever reads the third «آيات» [in the accusative] has committed a grammatical error (laḥn). Among those who said this is Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad]. Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] used to argue for Sībawayh on conjunction upon two governing words that whoever reads «آيات» in the nominative has also conjoined upon two governing words, because he conjoined «واختلاف» to «وفي خلقكم» and conjoined «آيات» to the position; so conjunction upon two governing words has become [a matter of] consensus. The reading with the nominative is clear and needs neither argument nor contrivance. Al-Farrāʾ reported about the verse something other than what we have mentioned, namely that he permitted «واختلافُ الليل والنهار» in the nominative, both in it and in «آيات», making the alternation itself the signs. He spared [us] the trouble about it by saying: "And I have not heard anyone read it so."

nahhas-irab:6-6.t:
(تِلْكَ آياتُ اللَّهِ): a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); آيات الله may also be a badal (substitute) of تلك, the khabar then being (نَتْلُوها عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ). (فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَآياتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ) is the reading of the Medinans and Abū ʿAmr; the Kufans read «تؤمنون» with the tāʾ. Abū ʿUbayd rejected their view on the grounds that before it comes إِنَّ فِي السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَآياتٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ, and likewise «لقوم يوقنون» and «لقوم يعقلون»; so on this basis it was necessary in his view that it be (فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَآياتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ). He also rejected it on the grounds that before it comes تِلْكَ آياتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوها عَلَيْكَ, so how could there come after it «فبأيّ حديث بعد الله تؤمنون»?
Abū Jaʿfar said: This rejection is not binding, because His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: تِلْكَ آياتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوها عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ, even though it is an address to the Prophet ﷺ, he conveys from Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, all that was sent down to him. That being so, the meaning is: "Say to them: «فبأيّ حديث بعد الله وآياته تؤمنون»", and this meaning is sound. Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, said: وَالْمَلائِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ بابٍ سَلامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ [al-Raʿd: 23], that is, saying [peace be upon you].

nahhas-irab:7-10.t: It is narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās that he said: it was revealed about al-Naḍr ibn Kalada. «ويل» is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); we have explained it previously.

nahhas-irab:11-11.t:
The people of Mecca and ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar read «عذاب من رجز أليمٌ» with the nominative, as a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب. Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad] said: الرّجز is the harshest and most severe punishment; and he recited [a verse] of Ruʾba [metre: al-rajaz], verse 417:
كم رامنا من ذي عديد مبزي ... حتّى وقمنا كيده بالرّجز
(How many a one with numerous, overbearing men has aimed at us, until we crushed his scheme with severe punishment!)

nahhas-irab:12-12.t: (اللَّهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ): a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate).

nahhas-irab:13-13.t: (جَمِيعاً) is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). It is narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās that he read (جَمِيعاً مِنْهُ) [i.e. «مِنَّةً»], accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun). Abū Ḥātim permitted (جَمِيعاً مِنْهُ) [i.e. «مَنُّهُ»] with fatḥa on the mīm and in construct, also as a maṣdar, in the sense "He bestowed [it as] His bestowal". And it is narrated from Maslama that he read (جَمِيعاً مِنْهُ) [i.e. «مَنُّهُ»] in the nominative, with an implied mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: the source prints all three variants with the same vowelling as the standard reading; the bracketed forms are those implied by the explanations.]

nahhas-irab:14-15.t:
(يَغْفِرُوا) is in the position of the jussive (jazm). Al-Farrāʾ said: this is jussive by resemblance to the jussive of the condition, as though it were like your saying «قم تصب خيرا» ("Stand and you will attain good"), though it is not so. Abū Jaʿfar said: he holds that since it occurred in the response to a command, it is jussive even if it is not a response. This is not well grounded. More fitting in it is what I heard ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān report from Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad], from Abū ʿUthmān al-Māzinī; he said: the implied form is "Say to those who believe: forgive, [and] they will forgive". This is a well-grounded view with no difficulty in it, and it is a response, as you say: أكرم زيدا يكرمك ("Honour Zayd and he will honour you"), its implied form being "if you honour him, he will honour you".
Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr and ʿĀṣim read (لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْماً); Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb, al-Aʿmash, Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read «لنجزي قوما» with the nūn; and Abū Jaʿfar the reader read (لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْماً) [Translator's note: so in the source; from the discussion that follows, his reading is the passive «لِيُجْزَى قَوْماً»]. Abū Jaʿfar [al-Naḥḥās] said: The first and second readings are good, and their meaning is one, even though Abū ʿUbayd prefers the first, arguing that before it is قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ, so he prefers «ليجزي قوما» so that the pronoun refers back to the name of Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He. This does not necessitate a preference, because it is the speech of Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, and His revelation, so His saying, exalted be His praise, «لنجزي» is an informing about Himself, Majestic and Mighty is He.
As for (لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْماً) [i.e. «لِيُجْزَى»], Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] said: it is a grammatical error (laḥn) according to al-Khalīl, Sībawayh and all the Basrans. Al-Farrāʾ said: it is an error in appearance; and according to the Basrans it is an error both in appearance and in substance. Al-Kisāʾī permitted it only as an anomaly, in the sense "so that the requital may requite a people", implying «الجزاء»; and had he made it overt it would not be permissible, so how [can it be] when he has implied it? The grammarians are agreed that «ضرب الضربُ زيدا» ("the beating beat Zayd") is not permissible, to the extent that some of them said: «ضُرب زيدا سوطٌ» is not permissible, because سوط is a maṣdar [in sense]. A maṣdar is put in place of the agent only with genitive particles [present], when it is qualified; when it is not qualified, it is not permissible. This is stranger still: that a maṣdar be put in place of the agent, unqualified, alongside a noun that is not a maṣdar. There is also another defect in it: it implies الجزاء when there has been no prior mention of it, on the basis that «يجزي» indicates it; and this, even if it is permissible, is figurative usage. As for their recitation [metre: al-wāfir], verse 418:
ولو ولدت قفيرة جرو كلب ... لسبّ بذلك الجرو الكلابا
